sloka: स्थितोऽयम् इति मत्वा अहम् प्रविष्टः तु दुरासदम् ।तम् मे मार्गयतः तत्र गतः संवत्सरः तदा ॥४-१०-१९॥
transliteration: sthito'yam iti matvā aham praviṣṭaḥ tu durāsadam ।tam me mārgayataḥ tatra gataḥ saṁvatsaraḥ tadā ॥4-10-19॥

translations.english: 'Presuming that Sugriva was waiting there, I entered the formidable cave. While I was searching for the demon there, one year passed.
